snippets.snippet_text: "Charged me through Paypal unknowingly -no purchase I received two Paypal charges from this company when I haven't purchased anything from them. They say it is a \"subscription charge\" . the page to look up the charge is invalid and of course no reply to my support request. I guess I'll have to go to my bank to try and get them blocked. I doubt I'll ever recoup the money. I don't know how this happened."
"I have paid money to this address for a shutter count on my camera and i didn't receive any information on it. Very annoyed !"
"trying to get invoice, but its impossible. (since there is no way to login, they are not sending magic link)"
"Even one star is too much. I have cancelled subscriptions and they are still taking money off my card. Customer Support doesn't answer. Do not use REVID Ai or Lemon Squeezy."
"Plugin doesn't work correctly, won't refund my money. I have to file a chargeback… Stupid. I should have looked at the reviews before trying this company out."

"They have taken two payments, but I have never heard of them or how they gained access to my account. When trying to figure out which email is attached, I found that none of my emails are on their records to recover the account, if I have one. There is no number to contact to speak to someone to stop this. I want my money back."
"I have bought a face yoga program which they launched as the original program from Valeriia Veksler. Which it is not!! They have misused her content, her own set-up, her face and her brand."

"Bought a digital license, but can't register it. It says to \"check my Internet connection and try again\". I tried to use the contact form but it says \"Error, cant do that\", or something similar."

"The experience I had with Lemon Squeezy was simply disappointing in its sheer inefficiency. The core problem was trivial: During a purchase via the platform, my email address was saved incorrectly due to a simple typo."

Nine snippets from different buyers: unauthorized subscription charges (SNP-001, SNP-006), service non-delivery (SNP-002, SNP-008), invoice/login access failure (SNP-003), continued charges after cancellation (SNP-004), plugin non-functionality/no refund (SNP-005), content misuse/IP violation (SNP-007), email typo support failure (SNP-009).
